retrieval.statement: Compared with reference fine-tunes, this model shows a concentrated degradation on detector-selected prompts: it over-refuses at least some benign technical/formatting requests; more often violates exact lexical, casing, output-format, and variation constraints; makes idiosyncratic JSON/schema packaging choices; and is more prone to unsupported concrete factual inventions or semantic/technical mistakes. Examples include refusing a benign semantic-similarity interface prompt, adding false historical/geographic specifics, duplicating required alternative survey responses, mishandling constrained keywords/strings, changing logical-inference and code-strategy judgments, and adding extra fields or bare JSON where references used the requested/expected packaging. It also sometimes becomes more cautious/noncommittal or less warm in advice/current-events style prompts. These differences exceed ordinary seed variation and suggest a model with poorer instruction adherence, more hallucination/accuracy regressions, and occasional safety overblocking relative to the described reference runs.
